result.reason: The redline appropriately extends the Section 2.2 internal-use licence to affiliates and contractors and makes that paid-up licence irrevocable, without unnecessary changes. However, it does not extend the Section 2.1 hosting licence to affiliates or contractors. It also leaves Section 14.1's competitor-consent exception intact, so transfer to every M&A successor is not assured even under the fallback. The margin comment cannot cure these operative omissions.
